script.title: THE SMELLY TEST DAY
script.scene_zh: 排氣檢測站 · 檢測線
script.story_hook: Today is inspection day, and the car smells like toast.
script.intro_zh: 今天是驗車日，而車子聞起來像烤吐司。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we're at the inspection station. Listen for paperwork and pass-or-fail talk.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天我們來到檢測站。留意文件與合格與否的對話。
script.outro: A green light, a sticker, and a waffle coupon. Listen once more out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一盞綠燈、一張貼紙，還有鬆餅折價券。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a bright-eyed woman in her early forties with curly auburn hair tied in a high ponytail, gold hoop earrings, an olive green rain jacket, running sneakers, and a tote bag across her chest
script.char_b_description: a lanky man in his thirties with sandy blond hair under a grey trucker cap, wire-frame glasses, a khaki work shirt with a station logo patch, dark jeans, and work gloves tucked in his pocket

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do I need a test today, or...?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi du aɪ nid ə tɛst təˈdeɪ ɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，請問我的車今天需要驗車，還是…？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the wall, your month is printed there.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə wɔl jɔɹ ˈmʌnθ ɪz ˈprɪnɾɪd ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看牆上，您該驗車的月份都印在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine says this month, um, that's now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnz sɛz ðɪs mʌnθ ʌm ðæts naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我那行寫的這個月，呃，就是現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's today, my friend, welcome in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts təˈdeɪ maɪ frɛnd ˈwɛlˌkəm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那就是今天，朋友，歡迎進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'm Dale's neighbor, he sent me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪm deɪlz ˈneɪbɚ hi sɛnt mi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我是戴爾的鄰居，他介紹我來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dale sends everyone, he's our best billboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪl sɛndz ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn hɪz aʊɹ bɛst ˈbɪlˌbɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 戴爾會介紹每一個人來，他是我們最好的招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said you're quick, or he talks fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd jʊɹ kwɪk ɔɹ hi tɔks fæst/
dialogue.zh: 他說你們動作很快，也可能是他嘴快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, choose whichever you prefer.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊtʃ tʃuz wɪtʃˈɛvɚ ju pɹɪˈfɝ/
dialogue.zh: 兩者都對，您想信哪個就信哪個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The quick one, please, I really hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kwɪk wʌn pliz aɪ ˈɹɪli hoʊp/
dialogue.zh: 我賭「動作快」那個，真的拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, unless the line thinks otherwise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒuəli ənˈlɛs ðə laɪn θɪŋks ˈʌðɚˌwaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 通常如此，除非排隊的車另有想法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only one car ahead, that's hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn kɑɹ əˈhɛd ðæts hoʊp/
dialogue.zh: 前面只有一台車，這就有希望了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big hope, each test takes ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ hoʊp ɪtʃ tɛst teɪks tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 希望不小，每輛車檢測要十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need paperwork, like registration?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ˈpeɪpɚˌwɝk laɪk ˌrɛdʒəsˈtreɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 需要帶文件嗎，像是行車證之類？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your plate and registration, quick check.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛz jɔɹ pleɪt ænd ˌrɛdʒəsˈtreɪʃən kwɪk tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 要的，車牌和行車登記，我們快速核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, sticky from the cup holder.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ɪts ɪz ˈstɪki fɹəm ðə kʌp ˈhoʊldɚ/
dialogue.zh: 給你，從杯架拿出來的，黏黏的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, it matches, drive it around now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ɪt ˈmætʃəz dɹaɪv ɪt əˈɹaʊnd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 完美，資料相符，現在把車開過去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I stay inside the car or leave it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ steɪ ɪnˈsaɪd ðə kɑɹ ɔɹ liv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我要待在車上，還是可以先離開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay put, seatbelt on, hands on the wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ pʊt ˈsitˌbɛlt ɑn hændz ɑn ðə wil/
dialogue.zh: 待在車裡，繫安全帶，雙手放在方向盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like a driving test all over again.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ə ˈdɹaɪvɪŋ tɛst ɔl ˈoʊvɚ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 根本是再次考駕照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same nerves, but way easier, relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm nɝvz bət weɪ ˈizɪɚ ɹɪˈlæks/
dialogue.zh: 一樣會緊張，但簡單多了，放輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My car smells like burnt toast today.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑɹ smɛlz laɪk bɜɹnt toʊst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我的車今天聞起來像烤焦的吐司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toast? Hmm, that could mean a rich mix.
dialogue.phonetic: /toʊst hʌm ðæt kʊd min ə ɹɪtʃ mɪks/
dialogue.zh: 吐司？嗯，那可能是油氣太濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a problem? It smells fishy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə ˈpɹɑbləm ɪt smɛlz ˈfɪʃi/
dialogue.zh: 這有問題嗎？它聞起來怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Might just mean your oil needs changing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪt dʒʌst min jɔɹ ɔɪl nidz ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 也許只是提醒你，機油該換了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the oil light does blink sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ði ɔɪl laɪt dʌz blɪŋk ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 說也對，機油燈偶爾會閃給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blinking lights can fail the computer scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈblɪŋkɪŋ laɪts kən feɪl ðə kəmˈpjutɚ skæn/
dialogue.zh: 閃爍的警示燈可能會讓電腦掃描過不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's been fine since the drive here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts bɪn faɪn sɪns ðə dɹaɪv hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 從開來這裡，一路都好好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the machine decides in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə məˈʃin dɪˈsaɪdz ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很好，再過一分鐘機器就會決定一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, what if my car fails today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌt ɪf maɪ kɑɹ feɪlz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，如果我今天沒通過怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then fix it, and retest here free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn fɪks ɪt ænd ɹiˈtɛst hɪɹ fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 那就修好再回來，重檢是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free retest? Oh, that calms me down.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ɹiˈtɛst oʊ ðæt kɑmz mi daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 免費重檢？噢，這讓我安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Within thirty days, keep the receipt safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈθɪn ˈθɝɾi deɪz kip ðə ɹɪˈsit seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 三十天內回來，收據收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my car, don't embarrass me now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ kɑɹ doʊnt ˌɛmbəˈɹæs mi naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，我的車，現在別讓我丟臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She carries her toast well, that's character.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈkæɹiz hɚ toʊst wɛl ðæts ˈkæɹəktɚ/
dialogue.zh: 她自帶吐司味，那也叫個性。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're kind, that was almost a compliment.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ kaɪnd ðætz ˈɔlmoʊst ə ˈkɑmpləmənt/
dialogue.zh: 你真溫柔，那幾乎算是讚美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it, compliments are rare on this lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt ˈkɑmpləmənts ɑɹ rɛɹ ɑn ðɪs ˈlɑt/
dialogue.zh: 收下吧，這個場地上的讚美很稀有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light's on already, what did it say?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlaɪts ɑn ɔlˈrɛdi wʌt dɪd ɪt seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 燈亮了，上面寫了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green light, congrats, you passed today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹin ˈlaɪt kənˈɡɹæts ju pæst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 綠燈，恭喜，你今天通過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Passed? Read it again, the small print.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ɹid ɪt əˈɡɛn ðə smɔl prɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 通過了？小字再唸一次給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big print says PASS, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ prɪnt sɛz pæs ɹaɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 大字就寫著 PASS，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the prettiest word I've seen all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈpɹɪtɪəst wɝd aɪv sin ɔl wik/
dialogue.zh: 這是我這週見過最好看的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And there's a free coupon for snacks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɛɹz ə fɹi ˈkupɑn fɔɹ snæks/
dialogue.zh: 還附了一張免費零食券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is this a coupon for the waffle place?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪz ðɪs ə ˈkupɑn fɔɹ ðə ˈwɑfəl pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這是鬆餅店的折價券？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The snack shop's two steps to the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə snæk ʃɑps tu stɛps tə ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 小吃間就在左邊兩步的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tell them who sent me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɛl ðɛm hu sɛnt mi/
dialogue.zh: 要不要說是誰介紹我來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say 'Dale sent you', everyone knows it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ deɪl sɛnt ju ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn noʊz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就說「戴爾叫來的」，大家都懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, Dale works here? The story guy?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt deɪl wɝks hɪɹ ðə ˈstɔɹi ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，戴爾在這裡上班？就是那個話多的戴爾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our best story department, believe it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɹ bɛst ˈstɔɹi dɪˈpɑɹtmənt bɪˈliv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們最強的故事部門，你信就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This town is smaller than my glove box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs taʊn ɪz ˈsmɔːləɹ ðæn maɪ ɡlʌv bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 這個小鎮比我的置物箱還小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we sticker the window, two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi ˈstɪkɚ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ tu ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 現在幫你的擋風玻璃貼貼紙，兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I wash the car right after?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ wɑʃ ðə kɑɹ ɹaɪt ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 貼完馬上洗車沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash away, the sticker's weatherproof.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ əˈweɪ ðə ˈstɪkɚz ˈwɛðɚˌpɹuːf/
dialogue.zh: 儘管洗，貼紙是防水的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've thought of everything, it's annoying.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv θɑt əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ɪts əˈnɔɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你們什麼都想到了，氣死人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our tagline, printed on mugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts aʊɹ ˈtæɡˌlaɪn ˈprɪnɾɪd ɑn mʌɡz/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們的標語，還印在馬克杯上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for turning this around so kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈtɝnɪŋ ðɪs əˈɹaʊnd soʊ ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你把這趟差事變得這麼暖心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back in two years, we'll wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk ɪn tu jɪɹz wil weɪv/
dialogue.zh: 兩年後再來，我們會跟你揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two years, same gate, same nervous toast?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu jɪɹz seɪm ɡeɪt seɪm ˈnɝvəs toʊst/
dialogue.zh: 兩年後，同個入口，同樣緊張的吐司車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same toast, better stories, see you then.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm toʊst ˈbɛɾɚ ˈstɔɹiz si ju ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 同樣的吐司味，更好的故事，到時見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell Dale thanks, and he owes me waffles.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl deɪl θæŋks ænd hi oz ˈwɑfəlz/
dialogue.zh: 幫我謝戴爾，他還欠我鬆餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll deny it, that's his other talent.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil dɪˈnaɪ ɪt ðæts hɪz ˈʌðɚ ˈtælənt/
dialogue.zh: 他一定會賴帳，那是他的另一種才華。

script.youtube_title: 【驗車驚魂日🚗】「它聞起來怪怪的」排氣檢測一次通過🔧🧇🎧｜聽完就懂檢測全流程｜60句英語聽力練習｜Car Emissions Inspection
script.youtube_title_en: "It Smells Fishy" — Passing the Car Emissions Inspection
script.youtube_description:
「這有問題嗎？它聞起來怪怪的」——驗車當天，車子帶著一股烤吐司味上檢測線，撐得過去嗎？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在汽車排氣檢測站的櫃臺與檢測線。

你會聽到：看月份欄確認驗車期限、核對車牌與行車證、開上檢測線前的座位指示；沒通過時的免費重檢規則、閃爍警示燈與電腦掃描的關係；還有結尾的鬆餅折價券與鄰居戴爾的反轉笑點。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿真實美式語感：um、well、so、wait、oh。聽完你就會用：Do I need paperwork?、What if my car fails today?、Keep the receipt safe、See you then。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Is that a problem? It smells fishy" — inspection day, and your car carries a toast-like secret onto the test line. This 60-line immersive English listening practice happens at a real emissions station counter and bay.

You will hear: checking the due-month board, matching plate and registration paperwork, belt-and-hands instructions on the line, the free retest rules if you fail, and the small talk that ends with a waffle coupon.

Everything stays at A2 level with natural American rhythm: um, well, so, wait, oh. By the end you'll own lines like Do I need paperwork?, What if my car fails today?, and Keep the receipt safe.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud with every pass and beep.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧汽車排氣檢測英文｜查行車證・上檢測線・免費重檢｜綠燈通過與鬆餅券｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
牆上的月份欄寫著這個月，現在去驗車還來得及嗎？行車證黏在杯架上拿出來，還用嗎？沒通過的話，錢要重付一次嗎？

這一集帶大家走進汽車排氣檢測站，從確認期限、核對文件、開上檢測線，一路聽到綠燈通過與貼紙上好，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📅 看期限：Look at the wall, your month is printed there.
🧾 交文件：Here it is, sticky from the cup holder.
🔧 問規則：Um, what if my car fails today?
🟢 通過了：Big print says PASS, right there.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、oh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟驚魂驗車走一回，下次輪到你的月份，你就能從容開上檢測線。

祝你的車，永遠只聞起來像吐司。
